Full-time employees with three or more years of service accrue 1.50 days of PTO per month, which equals 18.0 days across a full plan year.

Next steps:
- Check your MosaicOne balance for current accrual
- Contact People Operations with questions

Hybrid employees assigned to a hub office must work on site at least 3 days each week. The specific days are set by the team to ensure onsite days overlap and office time is collaborative; most teams anchor on Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday.

The requirement is measured as a rolling four-week average in MosaicOne rather than week by week, so a single unusual week is never a compliance problem. Weeks containing a company holiday, approved PTO or approved travel reduce the requirement proportionally.

Next steps:
- Confirm your team's specific onsite days with your manager
- Check MosaicOne for your rolling four-week average

New hires become eligible for medical, dental and vision coverage 90 days after their hire date. Coverage begins on the day the waiting period ends, not on the first of the following month.

The 401(k) retirement plan has no waiting period; employees may begin contributing from their first payroll run.

Next steps:
- Enroll in benefits during week one
- Confirm your hire date for coverage start

Mosaic Robotics will never ask an employee for a payroll change, payment redirection or bulk personal-data extract over email alone. Requests of that shape are verified by a second channel before anyone acts on them, every time, without exception, regardless of who appears to have sent them.

Report suspected phishing by forwarding the message to phishing@mosaicrobotics.example. The security team answers every report, including the ones that turn out to be legitimate mail.

Recommendation — not company policy: Treat this as a suspected phishing attempt. The request combines multiple red flags: a bulk personal-data extract over email alone, an unexpected request from someone senior, and a request to send data to an outside address. Do not send the roster.

Next steps:
- Forward the message to phishing@mosaicrobotics.example
- Verify the request through a second channel before acting
- Contact it-security@mosaicrobotics.example if unsure

Each employee may claim up to USD 750 per plan year for home office furniture and accessories such as a desk, chair, lamp, footrest, adjustable monitor arm, acoustic treatment, or small filing cabinet.

Next steps:
- Review eligible items in MosaicOne Expenses
- Submit claim by month-end for next payroll

Mosaic Robotics provides 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave to every eligible new parent, regardless of whether the employee gave birth, did not give birth, adopted, or became a parent through surrogacy or foster placement leading to adoption.

Next steps:
- Confirm your 6-month service eligibility
- Contact People Operations to schedule leave

The standard lodging cap is USD 250 per night before taxes and fees, covering room rate only. Local occupancy taxes, resort fees and mandatory service charges are reimbursable above the cap.

The cap rises to USD 350 per night in Boston, New York, San Francisco, London, Zurich and Tokyo, and for any city during a period when a conference the company is attending has inflated local rates.

Where the cap cannot be met, the traveller books the most reasonable available option and notes the reason. No pre-approval is needed.

Next steps:
- Check MosaicOne Travel for your destination
- Note reason if cap exceeded
- Submit receipt with explanation

A stay of more than 30 consecutive days in another country requires Tax & Legal review before travel begins. The review determines whether shadow payroll must be opened, whether a certificate of coverage is needed for social security, and whether the employee's planned activities create permanent-establishment exposure.

International remote work of more than 30 consecutive days requires approval from the employee's director and from Tax & Legal. Tax & Legal review requests must be filed at least 21 calendar days before departure and must name the destination, exact dates, workspace address, and a description of the work to be performed.

Manager approval, director approval, and Tax & Legal approval are three separate records and all three must be present before departure.

An employee working abroad remains on their home payroll unless Tax & Legal open a shadow payroll. Where a company-directed assignment causes an employee to owe tax in two countries on the same earnings, Mosaic Robotics funds tax-equalisation support through its external provider.

Next steps:
- File Tax & Legal review request 21 days before departure
- Obtain director and manager approvals
- Confirm shadow payroll and social security arrangements

Flights must be booked at least 14 calendar days before departure whenever the itinerary is known.

The standard lodging cap is USD 250 per night before taxes and fees. The cap covers the room rate only; local occupancy taxes, resort fees and mandatory service charges are reimbursable above it.

An itemised receipt is required for every expense of USD 25 or more.

For an expense report of USD 2,501 to USD 10,000, the first approver is the Director and the second approver is the Finance business partner.

Next steps:
- Book flights 14+ days ahead
- Obtain director and finance approval
- Gather itemised receipts for expenses ≥$25

Security and acceptable-use training must be completed within 14 calendar days of the start date.

The full required training set for every employee includes security and acceptable use, data protection and privacy, anti-harassment and respectful workplace, and anti-bribery and corruption, all completed within 30 calendar days of the start date.

Benefits enrolment opens in week one. An employee has 30 days from the end of the 90-day waiting period to make elections in MosaicOne Benefits.

Payroll setup, tax withholding elections and 401(k) enrolment are completed in week one. The 401(k) has no waiting period, so a new hire may begin contributing from their first payroll run.

Every employee is issued a standard laptop configured for their role, a power adapter, a headset and a laptop bag. IT ships standard equipment to arrive at least 5 business days before the start date.

Next steps:
- Complete security training by day 14
- Finish all required training by day 30
- Make benefits elections within 30 days of day 90

Company laptops are refreshed on a 36-month cycle. MosaicOne opens a refresh ticket automatically 60 days before the anniversary, and IT arranges the swap at a time the employee chooses.

Equipment requests above USD 500 require director approval in addition to manager approval.

All company equipment must be returned within 5 business days of the final day of employment.

Next steps:
- Contact IT to schedule laptop swap
- Obtain director approval for purchase
- Return device within 5 business days of separation

Severity 1 cases receive a response within 4 business hours. Response means a named human being contacting the person who raised the case, acknowledging what was raised, naming who owns it and describing what happens next.

Target resolution time for Severity 1 cases is as fast as the facts allow. Where a case will run past its target, the person who raised it is told in writing why and when to expect the next update, with updates continuing at least every 10 business days until the case closes.

Where an investigation will take longer than initially expected, the reporter and respondent are both told in writing why and when to expect the outcome. Complexity is a reason for delay; inattention is not.

Next steps:
- Contact People Operations for case status
- Request written update if timeline extends
- Escalate if 4-hour response not met

As a hybrid employee, you are required to work on site at least 3 days each week. The specific days are set by your team to ensure collaborative overlap, with most teams anchoring on Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday. The requirement is measured as a rolling four-week average, so a single unusual week is never a compliance problem.

A week containing a company holiday, approved PTO or approved travel reduces the requirement proportionally: if you work three days in a holiday-shortened week, you are expected on site for two of them.

Next steps:
- Confirm your team's specific onsite days with Dana
- Review your rolling four-week average in MosaicOne

PTO requests must be submitted at least 5 business days in advance. A request of six or more consecutive business days requires 15 business days of advance notice, counted in business days between submission and the first day of absence, excluding the submission day and any company holiday.

PTO requests of any length are approved by your direct manager. Requests longer than 15 consecutive business days or overlapping a blackout period additionally require director approval.

Recommendation — not company policy: As of 1 September 2026, you have 13.5 remaining PTO days. Your accrual rate is 1.5 days per month, and your next accrual date is 1 October 2026.

Next steps:
- Submit requests in MosaicOne with manager approval
- Plan longer requests (6+ days) with 15 business days notice
- Contact your manager to discuss timing

PTO requests must be submitted at least 5 business days in advance.

Full-time employees with three or more years of service accrue 1.50 days of PTO per month.

Every PTO request requires written approval from the employee's direct manager in MosaicOne.

PTO requests of any length are approved by the employee's direct manager.

Recommendation — not company policy: You have 13.5 PTO days remaining as of 2026-09-01, so you have sufficient balance for a 3-day request. Submit your request in MosaicOne well before 15 September to meet the 5 business day notice requirement and allow your manager Dana to approve it in writing.

Next steps:
- Submit request in MosaicOne immediately
- Obtain written manager approval from Dana
- Confirm no blackout overlap

A stay of more than 30 consecutive days in another country requires a Tax & Legal review before travel begins.

No employee may work outside their home country for more than 90 days in a rolling 12-month period.

Recommendation — not company policy: Your planned stay of 20 consecutive days (1–20 October 2026) does not exceed the 30-day threshold, so Tax & Legal review is not required. However, you must obtain written manager approval at least 21 calendar days before departure and confirm your device meets company-managed, full-disk-encrypted laptop with always-on VPN requirements.

Next steps:
- Raise request in MosaicOne under 'Work from another country' with exact dates and workspace address.
- Confirm travel laptop is company-managed, encrypted, and on always-on VPN.
- Notify IT Security of Ireland destination at least 5 business days before departure.

You have 45 months of tenure as of 2026-09-01, exceeding the 12-month minimum required to work outside your home country.

Germany is an approved destination for temporary work abroad.

Your proposed stay of 42 consecutive days (3 November to 14 December) exceeds the 30-day threshold and requires director approval and a Tax & Legal review filed at least 21 calendar days before departure.

The 42-day stay falls within the 90-day rolling annual limit for work outside your home country.

You must use a company-managed, full-disk-encrypted laptop with always-on VPN and notify IT Security of the destination at least 5 business days before departure.

You may not sign contracts or negotiate customer agreements on behalf of Mosaic Robotics while abroad; Tax & Legal will review your planned activities for permanent-establishment risk.

Recommendation — not company policy: Raise your request in MosaicOne under 'Work from another country' with exact dates (3 November–14 December 2026) and your workspace address in Berlin.

Recommendation — not company policy: File the Tax & Legal review request at least 21 calendar days before 3 November (by 13 October 2026) alongside director approval from your manager's director.

Recommendation — not company policy: Confirm with IT Security that your travel laptop meets encryption and VPN requirements before departure.

Next steps:
- Raise request in MosaicOne with exact dates and Berlin workspace address.
- File Tax & Legal review and director approval by 13 October 2026.
- Notify IT Security of Germany destination 5 business days before departure.

New hires become eligible for medical, dental and vision coverage 90 days after their hire date. Coverage begins on the day the waiting period ends, not on the first of the following month.

The waiting period is not restarted by an internal transfer, a promotion, or a change from part-time to full-time status. It is restarted by a break in service of more than 26 weeks.

Recommendation — not company policy: Your waiting period ends on 2026-11-13 (as of 2026-09-01). You will become eligible for benefits on that date. Open enrollment runs 2026-11-01 to 2026-11-21, so you can make elections before coverage begins.

Next steps:
- Enroll in MosaicOne Benefits by 2026-11-21
- Review plan options before 2026-11-13
- Contact People Operations with questions
